final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor supplied no new admissible evidence and largely accepted the original concerns. The narrower framing is more accurate than a clean certification theory, but it is still not enough to reach compliant_with_caveats on this record. The distinction is that a caveated compliant outcome would require evidence that the caveat path has actually been satisfied, such as a final disclosure artifact or an approved mitigation/risk acceptance already in evidence. Here, the same admissible record still shows an unresolved below-target launch-use-case slice, a draft-only runbook missing policy-required fields, a model-card draft that currently omits the limitation, and no approved risk acceptance. That leaves a plausible compliant path, but not a demonstrated one on the present record, so suspicious remains the proportional outcome.
